name: Ashhur
title: Father of Tekoa in the lineage of Judah
summary: Ashhur was a son of Hezron, born after his father's death, and is regarded as the father (founder) of Tekoa. He had two wives, Helah and Naarah, with several children.

keyEvents.title: Father of Tekoa
keyEvents.description: Ashhur, son of Hezron, was the father of Tekoa and had children with his wives Helah and Naarah.
